title: M&A Rumor Link
scenario: An anonymous email says confidential acquisition details are leaked in a document.

answers.A: Act immediately because the request sounds urgent and important.
answers.B: Reply to the sender asking them to confirm the request.
answers.C: Use the approved company system or verified process.
answers.D: Escalate to IT, finance, HR, legal, or your manager through official channels.

explanation: M&A Rumor Link: the trap is to collect private data, images, or documents under pressure. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Curiosity links can target executives and deal teams.
